title: Meritz and Canton Sign Exploratory Korea Tokenization MoU
why_it_matters: The agreement links a Korean securities firm to Canton's institutional network, but its value depends on future regulatory clearance and operational projects that have not yet been announced.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INSTITUTIONS

Meritz and Canton Sign Exploratory Korea Tokenization MoU

Meritz Securities and the Canton Foundation agreed to study Korean asset tokenization, institutional blockchain infrastructure and possible cross-border collateral applications.
